## Drills

> [!problem] Three in series (d 1)
> Three equal resistors $R$ sit in series. Find the total resistance.
^inv-s12-tall

> [!solution]- Solution
> 1. Resistances in series add: $R + R + R = 3R$.
> Answer: $3R$.
